_comment: Copy this file to program_configuration.json (same folder) and fill it in. THAT file is gitignored and is the ONLY place credentials live -- nothing else in this repo should ever hold a secret. Every key here is also settable as -Dkey or an env var (dots become underscores, uppercased), which is how CI supplies them without a file. The top-level key is the environment name, selected by `env` in application.properties or -Denv=<name>; add a sibling block per environment.

stg._xray_comment: Result publishing. Xray CLOUD wants an API key PAIR (clientId + clientSecret, from Xray > Settings > API Keys). Xray SERVER / DATA CENTER wants a Jira personal access token in `token` and no pair at all. The flavour is inferred from `baseUrl` -- a self-hosted host means Server/DC -- or state it with `flavour`. `enabled` is the master kill switch and stays false until someone turns it on. `projectKey` is only needed on Server/DC when no testExecutionKey is given.
stg._jira_comment: Read-only Jira access for the story-to-test tooling (tools/jira/). `base_urls` is an ALLOWLIST: a story URL whose host is not listed is refused rather than fetched, so a pasted link cannot redirect the fetcher at an arbitrary target. `pat` is a personal access token -- it is sent as a header, never placed in a URL or a log line. Leave the whole block empty to disable the tooling.
